有一天孟子去了墓地玩儿，但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩，所以她决定了他们会搬家找更好的地方。她恐怕儿子的童年不会幸福，而且住在这儿教育不太好。因为她望子成龙，所以她会一直搬家才能找到质量好的教育。然后他们搬到了离城市更近的地方。

  her past correction (loose_clause_connection): ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence
  her past correction (he_scope_coordination): 孟子在墓地[-和]祭拜跟其他孩子
  her past correction (pronoun_name_zero_reference): ⟦孟子⟧从早到晚想玩玩儿 — her note: replace孟子with他

The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.
  rule card loose_clause_connection: Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.

[P51] 有一天孟子去【了】墓地玩儿

  her past correction (loose_clause_connection): ⟦孟子从早到晚想玩玩儿，所以他和朋友坐墓地在祭拜⟧ — her note: loosely connected with the preceding sentence

  her past correction (other): 孟子在墓地和[祭拜跟其他孩子→跟其他孩子祭拜]
  rule card loose_clause_connection: Make the relationship between clauses or sentences clear. Add or choose a connector, a purpose phrase, or a sequence marker that shows the real connection.
  rule card he_scope_coordination: 和/跟 + noun connects multiple nouns that share the same action. Do not use 和/跟 to connect clauses, verb phrases, or adjectives; if the noun is an accompanying object and does not do the action, use V.着 instead. Not an error: 和/跟 + noun is correct when the nouns share the same action, such as 一个男生和一个女生走…… . Do not flag an accompanying noun when it is correctly expressed with V.着.

[P52] 但是他妈妈觉得这是【不合适的地方让孩子玩】
  proposed by the AI checker: 但是他妈妈觉得这是[不合适的地方让孩子玩→不适合让孩子玩的地方] (the modifier and verb phrase are in the wrong order)
  proposed by the correction model: 但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适[-的地方]让孩子玩
  proposed by the correction model: 但是他妈妈觉得这是不合适的地方让孩子玩[+的地方]
  her past correction (verb_object_valency): 而是她觉得墓地[不合适→不适合]孩子们玩
  her past correction (negation_bu_mei): 孟母觉得这个环境[不对孩子的成长有→对孩子的成长没有]好处
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 就自己觉得我不想[我的儿子→儿子不应该]在这个地方长大
  rule card verb_object_valency: Use the verb structure that the verb allows: give it the needed object, and do not add an extra object after a V.+Obj. compound or complement. For example, 跑遍 + place, while 掉 cannot take an object by itself. Not an error: Do not flag 掉 when it is a resultative complement after another main action verb. 掉 can also be used in the structure 掉 + directional + place.
  rule card negation_bu_mei: Use 不 for a habit, routine, willingness, or general negation; use 没 for an action or event that did not occur. Use 没 + V. for a negated action event. Not an error: Do not use this rule for the pattern “不是……而是……”, which is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, or to correct something wrong.

[P53] 所以她【决定了他们会】搬家找更好的地方
  proposed by the AI checker: 所以她[决定了他们会→决定]搬家找更好的地方 (决定 should directly take 搬家 here)
  proposed by the correction model: 所以她决定[-了]他们会搬家找更好的地方
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 所以她决定[-了]他们会搬家找更好的地方 (no 了 after the mental-state verb 决定)
  her past correction (other): 所以[他们→我们]要搬家 — her note: in quoted speech
  her past correction (addition_repetition_connectors): 所以他们[再→又]搬家一次 — her note: 又for something already occurred
  her past correction (addition_repetition_connectors): 所以他们[再搬家→又搬家了] — her note: 又for something already occurred
  rule card no_le_mental_state: Mental-state verbs such as 决定 and 发现 normally do not take 了 when they express a decision or discovery in the narrative. Not an error: Apply this rule when 决定 or 发现 expresses the decision or discovery in this narrative use.
  rule card addition_repetition_connectors: Use 又 for something that happened again, 也 for similarity, 还 for an added or surprising point, and 并 to make an addition more coherent. Put 也 after the subject (Subj.也), and put 又 before a modal V. (又+ modal V.). Not an error: Do not add an additive connector when the sentence does not show repetition, similarity, or an added point. Use 就, not 还, for a natural continuation rather than a surprising or angry one.

Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.
